title: A GTK program freezes for good when it opens a popup, because decade never configures popups
body:
`XdgShellHandler::new_popup`, `grab` and `reposition_request` in `src/server/compositor.rs` are empty. decade never sends an xdg popup its first configure, never draws it, and never routes input to it.

GTK4 creates popovers, context menus and tooltips as xdg popups. After it creates one, GTK blocks in a nested `wl_display_dispatch_queue` until the popup's first configure arrives. While it waits it handles no other Wayland event. A right click in a ghostty pane opens ghostty's context menu, and ghostty freezes for good. It takes no keys and draws nothing. The x on the pane's Ctrl bar does nothing either, because the close request waits behind the configure that never comes. Only killing the process frees the pane. Jack reproduced this by right-clicking a second ghostty.

A backtrace of the frozen ghostty's main thread:

```text
#1  ppoll () from /usr/lib/libc.so.6
#3  wl_display_dispatch_queue_timeout () from /usr/lib/libwayland-client.so.0
#4  wl_display_dispatch_queue () from /usr/lib/libwayland-client.so.0
#5-7  ?? () from /usr/lib/libgtk-4.so.1
#9  g_signal_emit_valist () from /usr/lib/libgobject-2.0.so.0
#11 gtk_widget_show () from /usr/lib/libgtk-4.so.1
```

Every GTK program decade hosts freezes the same way on its first popup. The fault probably accounts for part of decade-8a8093.

## Proposal

decade handles every xdg popup:

- It answers `new_popup` with a configure from the positioner's geometry, constrained to the parent pane.
- It tracks popups with smithay's `PopupManager` and draws each one over its parent's pane, nested popups included.
- It routes pointer input to the popup under the pointer. A popup that asks for a grab gets the keyboard and pointer until it is dismissed, and a click outside dismisses it.
- It answers `reposition_request`.

## Rejected

Sending the configure without drawing the popup. ghostty would unfreeze, but an invisible menu would hold the grab.
close_reason: Landed in 803bdf7, with the two gaps Jack approved closed in da44cda. Re-placing a popup on pane resize is left until it causes trouble. Jack has not yet tried it on a restarted server.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/7403d304
notes.text:
The fix is in the working tree on `dev`, not committed. `State` holds a `PopupManager`, `commit` sends a popup's first configure, `new_popup` and `reposition_request` place the popup inside the parent pane's client area (`popup_geometry`), `grab` uses smithay's `PopupKeyboardGrab` and `PopupPointerGrab`, `paint_clients` draws popups over their toplevel, and `pointer_moved` gives the pointer to the topmost popup under it. smithay's `desktop` feature is now on in `Cargo.toml`.

Gaps left:

- A click on decade's own chrome returns before it reaches the pointer, so it does not dismiss an open menu.
- While a popup holds the grab, decade's focus keys such as Super+h move nothing, because the keyboard stays with the menu.
- A popup is not placed again when its pane resizes.
- `decade script` sends only left clicks, so no end-to-end test covers a right-click menu. Jack is to confirm it by hand.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/7403d304
notes.text: Committed in 803bdf7. It stays open until Jack has tried a right-click menu in ghostty on a server built from it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/7403d304
notes.text: Jack approved closing two of the gaps: a click on decade's own chrome dismisses an open popup and then acts, and a decade keybind such as Super+h dismisses it and then acts. Re-placing a popup when its pane resizes waits until it causes trouble.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/7403d304
notes.text: Jack tried it on a server built from 9abf930: a right-click menu in ghostty opens, works and closes, and decade's chrome and keybinds dismiss it.
